request.description: Start a new process, or attach to an existing one.

program.description: Executable to debug (launch only). Use a path inside the pixi environment to debug the project's own tools.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debuggee (launch only).

env.description: Extra environment variables for the debuggee. The pixi environment's PATH is already applied by the extension.

processId.description: Process id to attach to (attach only).

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the first line of the program.
